title: Signal Slicer: Enterprise Ask Triage & Initial Implementation Outline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an MVP pipeline and lightweight tooling that aggregates non-bug enterprise feature requests from Sales/CS, applies deterministic de-duplication and a transparent priority score, and outputs a curated, exportable list for PM review. Goal: reduce repeated manual consolidation work for PMs and shorten time from customer ask to first-scope decision. The deliverable is a narrow-scope product flow (ingest -> normalize -> score -> export/create-ticket) plus a short runbook for CS to submit asks and guidance for PMs on interpreting scores.
acceptance_criteria: CS can submit enterprise asks via: a short web form + Slack slash command + webhook (we will support at least one in MVP)
Ingestion normalizes fields: account, product area, ask summary, customer priority, ARR signal (if provided), and contact
System deduplicates asks by fuzzy-title and account crosswalk and emits a cluster id for related asks
A transparent scored output is produced for each cluster: impact (0-10), strategic account weight (0-10), implementation effort estimate (t-shirt), and final composite score
PM can export top-N scored clusters as CSV and create a Linear ticket from an entry via one-click (pre-populate title and links)
Basic logging and an audit trail link back to original CS submissions are available for at least 30 days
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff w/ Sales, CS, Solutions Eng. Agreed on three submission channels: web form, Slack slash command, and a lightweight webhook for CS tooling. Sales requested ARR and opportunity stage fields.

2026-03-04 - Engineering (Dante Morales) sketched two ingest options: (A) simple POST webhook -> store in Postgres; (B) event-stream to Kafka with consumers for dedupe. Recommended A for MVP to reduce infra scope.

2026-03-05 - Prototype scoring rules proposed: impact = customer specified priority + ARR band normalization; strategic weight = account tier mapping from GTM; effort = quick t-shirt by Eng steward. Need product review on fairness and bias.
2026-03-08 - Sales feedback: must preserve verbatim customer language for quote context; avoid over-normalizing titles. Request ability to flag an ask as 'time-sensitive' which should nudge score.
2026-03-09 - Design (Priya Rao) delivered low-fi export UI and export CSV columns. UX note: add a confidence indicator and reviewer notes field.

2026-03-10 - Decision: scope MVP to ingestion + clustering/dedupe + deterministic scoring + export/create-ticket. Defer advanced ML-based clustering and auto-prioritization to next phase. Action items: Eng to deliver webhook + simple UI by 2026-03-18; PM to produce scoring rubric doc and runbook for CS; Design to produce final mockups for the create-ticket flow.
